name: 27299-longprefill-granite4htiny-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine, one rank, one GPU.
architecture: GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM, a hybrid Mamba-2 / attention sparse-MoE decoder: 40 layers, bfloat16, ~6.94 B parameters, ~13.9 GB of weights, 131072-token window. Public, ungated, Apache-2.0. Full geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 64 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion, leaving ~52 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt exactly 131000 tokens and output exactly 32 (131032 of the 131072-token window), `request_format: plain` at `temperature: 0.0`, ignore_eos on, prefix caching off, static seed 27299.
purpose: A whole-document analysis assistant reading 131,000-token filings one request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 66a168a197ba214a5b70a74fa2e713c9eeb3251a (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.11.1rc3-6-g66a168a197, 2025-10-25). Nothing here is tuned: no tunable.yaml, no tuned.yaml.

model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-tiny

tensor-parallel-size: 1

max-num-batched-tokens: 32768

# Do not delete this as "the default". The async engine path does not go through
# `_set_default_args` at this commit, so an unpinned run inherits whatever the library
# default becomes. 128 is that default written down; it cannot bind at one stream.
max-num-seqs: 128

enable-chunked-prefill: true

# The checkpoint's own ceiling, written out because the workload sits at 99.97% of it.
max-model-len: 131072

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
